title: Modern jazz pianists he admires
summary: Hug praises Shearing, Jamal, Garner and Bill Evans.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Who do you like or do you have any taste for the modern jazz pianists of today? Do you find any kinship with them in particular?

Oh, definitely Charlie, definitely. I follow the pianists, I guess, practically all of them. I've lost track of some of the modern ones because they're coming so fast these days that I just can hardly keep up with them. But I've kept up with most of them and I just think that they're just the greatest. Like for instance, I think George Shearing is superb. I think Amma Jamal is. I think Errol Garner in his own way. I mean a lot of people just don't particularly care for him, but I think he's real great. And, well, for instance, even today, Bill Evans, I've heard some of his recordings and my God, I just think they're terrific. I think he has a wonderful feeling for jazz.
